newsitem.title: UK: PDFM confirms sale of 60 mln Clyde shares.
newsitem.headline: PDFM confirms sale of 60 mln Clyde shares.

text.p: PDFM, Clyde Petrolem Plc's second biggest shareholder, said on Wednesday that it had sold its entire stake in the company to hostile bidder Gulf Canada on Tuesday.
In a rule 8 disclosure PDFM said it had sold 60.6 million shares at 120 pence per share, the level of Gulf Canada's offer.
Before the sale PDFM had held a stake of around 16 percent in Clyde.
Earlier on Wednesday Gulf Canada said it now held 29.3 percent of Clyde's shares, close to the maximum which it is allowed to purchase on the open market.
Gulf Canada's offer closes on February 18.
